description: Probe the host now and store what was seen. The ONLY way to reach `active`, and only after reaching this product on that host — DNS resolving is not enough. The only operation that can move a tracking domain to `active`, and it does so only after reaching this product's own health endpoint ON that host. A host that used to answer and stopped becomes `failed`, and links go back to the platform origin immediately.
name: commsharbor_tracking_domain_verify
